title: Snapchat Conversion Event
description: Schema for validating Snapchat Conversions API (CAPI) v3 event payloads sent via the server-to-server integration for web, app, and offline conversion tracking.

data.description: Array of conversion event objects to submit. Maximum 2,000 events per request.

ConversionEvent.description: A single conversion event with event metadata, user identification data, and optional custom data.

event_name.description: The name of the conversion event being reported.

event_time.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the event occurred. Events can be up to 37 days in the past.

event_source_url.description: The URL of the web page where the event occurred. Required for web events.

event_id.description: A unique identifier for the event, used for deduplication across multiple submissions.

action_source.description: The source indicating where the conversion event originated.

UserData.description: User identification data for matching conversion events to Snapchat users. All PII fields should be SHA-256 hashed before sending.

em.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase email address of the user.

ph.description: SHA-256 hashed phone number in E.164 format.

fn.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase first name of the user.

ln.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase last name of the user.

db.description: SHA-256 hashed date of birth in YYYYMMDD format.

st.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase two-letter state code.

country.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase two-letter country code.

external_id.description: SHA-256 hashed external identifier for the user.

client_ip_address.description: The IP address of the user's browser or device.

client_user_agent.description: The user agent string of the user's browser.

sc_click_id.description: The Snapchat click ID from the ad click URL parameter.

CustomData.description: Custom data associated with the conversion event, such as purchase details and product information.

price.description: The monetary value or price associated with the event.

transaction_id.description: A unique transaction identifier for deduplication.

search_string.description: The search query string for SEARCH events.

sign_up_method.description: The method used for sign-up (e.g., email, google, facebook).

num_items.description: Number of items associated with the event.

payment_info_available.description: Whether payment info is available (1) or not (0).

contents.description: Array of product or content items associated with the event.

ContentItem.description: A product or content item associated with a conversion event.

item_price.description: The price of the individual item.

brand.description: The brand name of the item.

AppData.description: App-specific data for mobile app conversion events.

advertiser_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the user has enabled advertiser tracking.

application_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the app has tracking enabled.
